title: OSS LLM span shows the LLM metrics row and hides the Scores block
verifies: an LLM span renders the observation badge and LLM metrics row while the Scores block stays hidden on an OSS build

title: Non-LLM span shows no observation badge and no Scores block
verifies: a plain span opens the sidebar with no LLM badge and no Scores block (negative control)

title: LLM span without a response model shows the badge but no metrics row / Scores
verifies: an LLM span lacking gen_ai_response_model shows the badge but not the metrics row or Scores block
